verdict.rationale: Conductor isolates each agent task in its own git worktree/branch or cloud sandbox that spins up in seconds, letting agents test, build, and run install scripts without touching the main/production branch (docs-2, docs-17, docs-20, comm-17). However, the evidence frames isolation in terms of code branches/workspaces, not literal 'production data' (e.g., databases or live services), and community comments raise concerns about broad GitHub write access and unclear data practices, suggesting the sandbox boundary is not airtight. Missing for 10: explicit handling of production data/environment separation (vs just code branches), and independent verification that sandboxes never touch live data or credentials.
